text_of_record.text:
1. **Offset GQ normalization, ruled before any signed-state number.**
   - If 0528 item 1 stands and M_B ≈ M_A, no tail-ON call can pass acceptance (FORMAL).
   - **Recommendation (FORMAL):** adopt the max-component normalization (≤ 2b/(1−z)) for offset stages only, on physics grounds. Signed P0 divides by a net zero mode that is zero by construction, so it certifies nothing about quadrature accuracy.
   - This changes a registered reading (A115(b)). Codex1 builds one successor set (signed_bound, evidence v004, enumerator v010 and the certificate guard), and Claude3 reviews it.
